title: Endpoint variation test only runs the default case
reasoning: test_fast_on_date_endpoint_variations is written as a unittest test method with optional parameters, so the test runner invokes it only once with query_params='' and culmination_feast_name=None. The branches for non-empty query parameters and culmination feast handling are not actually exercised unless another test calls this helper, and no such caller appears in the included excerpt.
recommendation: Convert this into explicit test methods or pytest parameterization so each intended variation is executed by the test runner.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The current method defaults allow discovery to pass while silently skipping the named variations.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add separate discovered tests for a query-parameter case and a culmination-feast case, asserting the expected countdown output for each.
minimumFixScope: Refactor tests/integration/test_endpoints.py so the variation cases are real discovered tests.
